papers.title: Beyond social facilitation and inhibition: Experimenter presence regulates executive function engagement in children.
papers.reason: The paper directly studies children's executive function under working-memory load and uses drift diffusion modeling to interpret Go/no-Go performance.

papers.title: Scalable big data analytics for neuro-control: An HPC parallel architecture for synchronization suppression in fNIRS networks
papers.reason: The paper is about HPC acceleration for neuro-control simulations rather than human or animal executive cognition.

papers.title: Functional and Effective Connectivity Characteristics of the Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex in Drug-Naïve Patients with Generalized Anxiety Disorder
papers.reason: The study reports human dLPFC connectivity abnormalities linked to attentional bias and cognitive control in generalized anxiety disorder.

papers.title: Central nervous system involvement, sequelae, and prognostic markers in children with severe hand-foot-and-mouth disease: A multicenter cohort study across four Chinese cities.
papers.reason: The paper concerns broad neurological and developmental sequelae after severe infection, with only indirect relevance to executive function assessment or modelling.

papers.title: Survival analysis of spontaneous speech for predicting mild cognitive impairment-to-dementia conversion.
papers.reason: The paper evaluates speech-derived digital biomarkers from verbal fluency for longitudinal prediction of MCI-to-dementia conversion.

papers.title: Sex differences in parietal alpha power during sustained attention are related to conflict monitoring performance in mild cognitive impairment.
papers.reason: The title indicates an EEG study linking alpha power to sustained attention and conflict monitoring in mild cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Designing and Evaluating a Clinical Decision Support System to Assess Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.reason: The paper involves game-based digital biomarkers for MCI assessment, but its main contribution is evaluation of an explainable clinical decision support interface.

papers.title: Electrophysiological Evidence of Cognitive Dysfunction After tSAH: An ERP Study Based on Three Different Stimulation Paradigms
papers.reason: The study uses P300, MMN, and CNV ERPs to characterize cognitive resource allocation and dysfunction after traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage.

papers.title: Auditory Steady-State Responses in Adults Aged 88–95 Years Measured in a Home Setting: Feasibility and Agreement with Pure-Tone Audiometry
papers.reason: The paper focuses on peripheral hearing assessment feasibility in very old adults rather than executive function, cognitive modelling, or cognitive impairment biomarkers.
